head.t: Free Diabetes UK webinar series to inspire better diabetes care this winter
head.x: Healthcare professionals are being invited to join a free winter webinar series from Diabetes UK, bringing together expert knowledge, real-world experiences and practical ideas to help improve diabetes care and outcomes.
This day aims to inspire and celebrate educating in the challenging specialty of emergency medicine, and showcase upcoming research from the educators of the future.
